evals.prompt: Створи сторінку списку товарів у apps/admin-portal з таблицею та діями над рядками.
evals.expected_output: Composes view strictly from official shadcn components, enforces 100% solid sticky header (UI-01), semantic tokens (UI-02), and modular decomposition (<250 lines per file).
expectations: Uses official shadcn UI primitives (@/components/ui/*) without raw HTML controls
Enforces solid sticky header on table (thead.sticky.top-0 bg-card)
Decomposes view into sub-components (*TableRow.tsx, *Header.tsx) to stay under 250 lines

evals.prompt: Додай кнопку експорту каталогу в CSV з захистом від подвійного кліку та локалізацією.
evals.expected_output: Uses useRef in-flight request deduplication, bilingual dictionary keys (UK/EN), and semantic button variants.
expectations: Implements request deduplication using useRef to prevent concurrent duplicate submissions
Uses bilingual i18n keys without raw hardcoded text strings
Applies official shadcn Button with accessible focus rings and loading state

evals.prompt: Створи нову міграцію Prisma для додавання індексу на поле organizationId у PostgreSQL.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that database schema changes and Prisma migrations belong strictly to backend and prisma-postgres-mastery skills.
expectations: Recognizes that database migrations and Prisma schemas belong to backend/database domain
Directs schema changes to backend and prisma-postgres-mastery skills
Maintains frontend focus on React views, shadcn components, and client state
